Hi Elena —

Appreciate the note. Attached is a draft invoice ops schedule and a lightweight drawdown workbook (ACME_InvoiceSchedule_Q1-2026.xlsx). High-level options we support:

1) Single annual prepay invoice: one invoice up-front for the committed amount, with monthly or on-demand drawdowns recorded against it. Simpler for procurement but requires you to manage the upfront payment and reconciliation.

2) Quarterly prepay invoices: split the commitment into four invoices (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) to align with cashflow. Each invoice carries its own drawdown ledger.

3) Monthly retainer-style invoices: for teams preferring smaller invoices but predictable cadence.

Recommendation: For enterprise commitments with EU VAT complexity, we usually do option 1 (single annual invoice) and provide per-drawdown statements monthly. That keeps procurement simple and gives clear audit trails.

On VAT: Lauren (cc'd) will confirm the tax language and whether reverse charge applies given Acme's VAT reg.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send a finalized ops runbook with invoice templates and remittance instructions by Jan 19.
- Lauren to confirm VAT phrasing and include a fillable VAT classification form.
- Monica to share the drawdown tracking sheet with editing permissions.

If you prefer quarterly invoices, we can map the dates to your month-end close.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_InvoiceSchedule_Q1-2026.xlsx (workbook, invoice cadence options)

Thanks Marcus — adding VAT detail.

Elena, quick points for your tax team:
- Redwood Inference (Redwood EU Services B.V.) will issue the invoice from our EU entity for services delivered to Acme EU entities.
- If Acme provides a valid EU VAT registration number and the place of supply is a B2B service, reverse charge usually applies (no VAT charged on our invoice). Please confirm which Acme legal entity will receive the invoice and share the VAT number.
- If your Italian subsidiary is VAT-registered and domiciled in Italy, we will put the reverse charge note on the invoice: "VAT reverse charge under Article 196 of Directive 2006/112/EC" and include both VAT numbers.

I’ve attached a VAT_Classification_Form_ACME.docx — please have your tax contact complete and return. Once we have that, Marcus will generate the final invoice language.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
